lines.trans: Nastya, why are you crying so bitterly?
Max treated me very badly.
What did this guy do again?
He said that we are just friends.
Do not be upset over a foolish cook.
I feel very hurt and sad.
Wash your face with cold water and calm down.
Thank you for the support, Victoria Sergeevna.
Return to the dining hall, the guests are waiting for their order.
I already dried my tears and am ready.
Good girl, work cures everything!
You are absolutely right, I am going to work!
